title: Evaluating Investment Logic in Large Language Models: A Real-World Benchmark Towards Personalzied Financial Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.06108v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Investment competence is inherently personalized: the same market evidence can justify different actions for investors with different goals, horizons, portfolios, and risk boundaries. Yet financial LLMs are evaluated either by static question answering or by terminal profit and loss. The former omits agency; the latter cannot reveal whether a profitable action was grounded, profile-consistent, or merely lucky. We ask whether the community is using the wrong ruler for consequential agents.   We introduce \textsc{InvestLogicBench}, a process-native benchmark containing 201,247 documented decisions from 151 real-world investors. Each episode instantiates a \textbf{P$\rightarrow$E$\rightarrow$R$\rightarrow$D$\rightarrow$O} trace: investor \textit{Profile}, observable market \textit{Events}, investment \textit{Reasoning}, executable \textit{Decision}, and delayed \textit{Outcome}. translated_title: 评估大型语言模型中的投资逻辑：迈向个性化金融代理的真实世界基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.06108v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：投资能力本质上是个性化的：相同的市场证据可以对具有不同目标、时间跨度、投资组合和风险边界的投资者证明不同的行动是合理的。然而，金融大语言模型要么通过静态问答进行评估，要么通过最终盈亏进行评估。前者忽略了代理性；后者无法揭示盈利行为是否基于依据、符合个人画像，或仅仅是运气。我们质疑社区是否在对具有重大影响的代理使用错误的衡量标准。我们引入了\textsc{InvestLogicBench}，一个流程导向的基准，包含来自151位真实投资者的201,247条记录决策。每个事件实例化了一个\textbf{P$\rightarrow$E$\rightarrow$R$\rightarrow$D$\rightarrow$O}轨迹：投资者\textit{画像}、可观察的市场\textit{事件}、投资\textit{推理}、可执行的\textit{决策}，以及延迟的\textit{结果}。发布内容包括画像构建、时点数据等。
tldr: 本文提出了InvestLogicBench，一个基于真实投资者决策流程的基准，用于评估金融大语言模型是否在投资推理中兼顾个性化画像和逻辑依据，而非仅关注结果盈亏。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces InvestLogicBench, a process-native benchmark based on real investor decision traces, to evaluate whether financial LLMs align reasoning with personalized profiles and logic rather than just terminal outcomes.
